intro: Dirge Quikcleave keeps his word and hands over the five-hundred-pound chicken. You carry it to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. This comes after Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken.
What a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...
Probably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Narain mashes two fists into the huge chicken, stuffing his face full of Dirge's delicious delicacy.
MMmmm... This is unbelievable! Best chicken I've ever had!
